description: Add PWA support: service worker for offline mode, web app manifest, install prompt, and offline-first caching strategy for questions and flashcards
steps: Create public/manifest.json web app manifest with: name 'CFA Buddy', short_name 'CFA Buddy', theme_color '#002B5C', background_color '#0a0e14', display 'standalone', start_url '/', icons referencing the existing logo at public/CFA Buddy_logo.png (create appropriately sized icon files if needed)

Create public/sw.js service worker with offline-first caching strategy: cache static assets (JS, CSS, images) on install, cache question bank data and flashcard data for offline access, serve from cache first with network fallback for cached resources, network first with cache fallback for API routes
Create src/features/pwa/ directory: types/, utils/, components/
Create src/features/pwa/utils/register-sw.ts utility that registers the service worker on app mount, handles updates, and manages the install prompt event
Create src/features/pwa/utils/offline-cache.ts utility that pre-caches question bank data from localStorage into the Cache API for offline access
Create src/features/pwa/components/install-prompt.tsx - shows an install banner/button when the beforeinstallprompt event fires. Dismissable, persists dismissal to localStorage
Create src/features/pwa/components/offline-indicator.tsx - shows a subtle indicator when the app detects it's offline (navigator.onLine)
Create src/features/pwa/components/pwa-provider.tsx - wraps the app to register service worker and manage PWA state (online/offline, installable)
Add manifest link and meta tags to src/app/layout.tsx: <link rel='manifest' href='/manifest.json'>, theme-color meta tag, apple-touch-icon
Integrate PwaProvider into the app layout (src/app/layout.tsx or src/app/(protected)/layout.tsx)
Add unit tests in src/features/pwa/__tests__/register-sw.test.ts testing: registration logic, offline detection, install prompt handling
Run full verification: npm run lint, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run build, npm run test
acceptance_criteria: public/manifest.json exists with correct PWA metadata
public/sw.js service worker caches static assets and question data
App shows install prompt when installable
Offline indicator shows when user loses connection
Questions and flashcards work offline via cached data
Manifest link and meta tags present in HTML head
All tests pass, lint clean, build succeeds
verification: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run lint
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run build
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run test
findings: manifest.json and sw.js already existed with basic structure. Enhanced sw.js with proper caching strategies (cache-first for static assets, network-first for HTML/API). Created full pwa feature module at src/features/pwa/ with types, utils, components, and tests. Integrated PwaProvider into root layout. Removed inline script SW registration in favor of the PwaProvider component. Added Viewport export for theme-color meta tag (Next.js App Router pattern). All 379 tests pass, lint clean, build succeeds.
